description: Returns up to 16 consecutive transcript segments from one episode around a timestamp (m:ss or h:mm:ss), a segment_index from search results, or a passage url or its #t- anchor. Defaults: 2 segments before and 5 after. Each segment has its own url to cite.

at.description: Segment index from search results, passage URL or #t- anchor, m:ss or h:mm:ss.

name: get_transcript_excerpt
title: Get transcript excerpt
